# Lab 25.2: Batch SQL Translator

## What We Are Going to Do
Translate a folder of SQL scripts from Cloud Storage in one job and read the translation report.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create sample source scripts.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">mkdir -p td_scripts
cat &gt; td_scripts/01_create.sql &lt;&lt;'EOF'
CREATE MULTISET TABLE sales (customer_id INTEGER, amount DECIMAL(10,2), sale_date DATE) PRIMARY INDEX (customer_id);
EOF
cat &gt; td_scripts/02_report.sql &lt;&lt;'EOF'
SEL customer_id, SUM(amount) FROM sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' GROUP BY 1;
EOF
cat &gt; td_scripts/03_update.sql &lt;&lt;'EOF'
UPD sales SET amount = amount * 1.1 WHERE customer_id = 7;
EOF
export BUCKET=$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs
gcloud storage cp td_scripts/*.sql gs://$BUCKET/translate/input/</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Start a batch translation.** **Migration → Services → SQL translation → Start translation**:
   - **Name**: `teradata-batch`, **Location**: US
   - **Source dialect**: Teradata SQL
   - **Source location**: `gs://YOUR_BUCKET/translate/input/`
   - **Target location**: `gs://YOUR_BUCKET/translate/output/`

3. **[CLI] Download the results.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage ls gs://$BUCKET/translate/output/
gcloud storage cat gs://$BUCKET/translate/output/02_report.sql</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Read the report.** Open the job's **Translation report**. It lists every file, the number of errors and warnings, and the issue category (for example, `MULTISET` and `PRIMARY INDEX` have no direct BigQuery equivalent).

5. **Improve accuracy.** For real migrations, also upload the source DDL metadata (from `dwh-migration-dumper`, Lab 25.4), so table and column names are translated correctly.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Input | Folder of scripts in Cloud Storage |
| Output | Translated scripts + report |
| Report | Errors and warnings per file |
| Accuracy | Better with metadata |
